name: OWASP API Security Top 10
disclaimer: Independent academic static-analysis mapping to OWASP API Security Top 10 (2023). No OWASP endorsement or certification is claimed.

controls.title: Broken Object Level Authorization
controls.description: Object access based on client-controlled identifiers may lack per-object authorization.
controls.verification_guidance: Test access to each object using identities with different ownership and permissions.

controls.title: Broken Authentication
controls.description: Weak or incorrectly implemented authentication can allow an attacker to impersonate a client.
controls.verification_guidance: Test credential issuance, validation, expiration, and session/token handling.

controls.title: Broken Object Property Level Authorization
controls.description: API responses or updates may expose or modify object properties without adequate authorization.
controls.verification_guidance: Test field-level read and write permissions, response schemas, and mass assignment.

controls.title: Unrestricted Resource Consumption
controls.description: Unbounded requests or processing can exhaust service resources or incur excessive cost.
controls.verification_guidance: Review request size, quotas, rate limits, timeouts, pagination, and expensive operations.

controls.title: Broken Function Level Authorization
controls.description: Users may access API functions outside their assigned role or permission level.
controls.verification_guidance: Test access to privileged functions under all supported roles and identities.

controls.title: Unrestricted Access to Sensitive Business Flows
controls.description: Automated or abusive access to sensitive workflows may cause business harm despite valid API use.
controls.verification_guidance: Identify high-impact workflows and test abuse resistance, quotas, and anomaly controls.

controls.title: Server Side Request Forgery
controls.description: Fetching a client-controlled URL can cause the API to access unintended internal or external services.
controls.verification_guidance: Trace user-controlled URLs into outbound requests and verify destination allowlisting.

controls.title: Security Misconfiguration
controls.description: Unsafe API or infrastructure settings can expose endpoints or weaken security controls.
controls.verification_guidance: Review CORS, TLS, debug settings, default configuration, and error responses.

controls.title: Improper Inventory Management
controls.description: Untracked API versions, hosts, or endpoints can remain exposed without security oversight.
controls.verification_guidance: Compare deployed services and versions with a current, owned API inventory.

controls.title: Unsafe Consumption of APIs
controls.description: Insufficient validation of third-party API responses can introduce malicious data or behavior.
controls.verification_guidance: Treat upstream data as untrusted and validate schemas, integrity, errors, and destinations.
